g.title: seq
g.text: 15b Transfer of funds from one agency to another body that will implement

a.text: 1. National agency to Implementing body:
Memorandum of agreement: purpose, amount
(enough for three months, or the total project
cost), period, reports
2. National agency: Obligation recorded
against its own allotment
3. National agency to Implementing body: Check
in the name of the implementing body. The
receiver issues an official receipt
4. National agency: Books: Due from National
Government Agencies (a receivable). Not yet an
expense, not yet a disbursement in the budget
reports
5. Implementing body: Trust fund books: Due to
NGAs (a liability). The money goes to a trust
account, or to the Treasury, from which DBM
gives an NCA for trust
6. Implementing body to Suppliers and payees:
Procurement, contract
7. Suppliers and payees to Implementing body:
Delivery, inspected and accepted
8. Implementing body to Suppliers and payees:
Payment from the trust account or under the
NCA for trust
9. Implementing body to National agency:
Within ten days after each month: reports of
checks issued and of cash disbursements,
approved by the head of the implementing body
10. National agency: Books: expense recorded,
receivable reduced. Now reported as disbursed.
The implementing body reduces its liability by
the same expenses

a.xlink:title: skip: Money remains at the end of the project or of the validity period

a.text: 11. Implementing body to National agency:
Unused balance returned, if the agreement says
so
12. National agency to DBM: FAR 1-C each
quarter: obligations, disbursements,
liquidations and balances of fund transfers

a.xlink:title: end of: Money remains at the end of the project or of the validity period

a.text: 13. COA to National agency: The auditor of the
implementing body audits its payments. The
auditor of the source agency audits the
transfer
